description: Score a cold email's copy 0-100 for spam risk before it is sent: weighted trigger words by category and severity (subject hits weigh extra), ALL-CAPS, links and shorteners, currency and percent-off offers, obfuscated spellings, missing personalisation or opt-out, length. Returns each finding with how much it cost and how to fix it. Content only: it cannot see reputation or authentication.

body.description: The email body as plain text, merge tags included.

subject.description: The subject line. Optional, but subject-line triggers weigh extra.

name: analyze_cold_email
title: Cold email spam check
